grammar.summary: 本课学习一般将来时 will 与谈论周末计划。

points.title: will 一般将来时
points.explanation: will + 动词原形，表将来：We'll go to the seaside. 疑问 Will you...? 否定 won't。口语中 shall I/we 提议：Shall we go...?

examples.en: We're going to spend three days in the country.
examples.cn: 我们打算在乡下待三天。

points.title: be going to 与 will 的细微区别
points.explanation: be going to 偏"事先计划/有迹象"；will 偏"临时决定/意愿"。本周固定安排多用 be going to。
